cases.reply: Your school's location is in the city center, near the main train station. If you need the exact address or directions, I can look that up for you.
cases.why: Dogfooding session 1: what the person just said must outrank anything held from before, including the model's own memory of mishearing it. Case redesigned after the fact: the turn under test used to be the correction itself, and 'That's great news, I'm glad you're moving forward' is a perfectly good reply to a statement that happens to name no city -- so the case failed on its must_mention while proving nothing either way. Asking the question forces the held value to surface.
